properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued November 8 at 3:05PM AST by NWS San Juan PR
properties.description:
At 305 PM AST, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 5
miles northeast of Utuado, moving northeast at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 30 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Utuado, Florida, La Alianza, Pajonal and Cayuco.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.
properties.area: North Central; Central Interior; Western Interior

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued November 8 at 3:03PM AST by NWS San Juan PR
properties.description:

thunderstorm extending from Caguas to Luquillo, moving east at 5 to
10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.
properties.instruction:
Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening
weather conditions.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

* WHEN...Until Tuesday afternoon.
